name: Gridset
description:
Most documents go out as walls of text because nobody has time to design them. Gridset fixes that from inside the chat. Describe what you need, paste your notes, and get back a designed, on-brand document or presentation in about a minute. Brand rules are enforced at the grid level, so what goes out is the version you want people to see.

With Gridset connected, Claude can:
- Create documents and presentations from notes, drafts, or pasted content
- Set up a brand automatically from a website address
- Find and open your existing Gridset documents
- Show pages in the conversation and make focused edits to a single page
- Rewrite rough notes into polished prose before any design work
- Export finished documents as PDF or PPTX

Everything stays editable in Gridset afterwards. Flexible enough to edit, structured enough to hold.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gridset to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gridset to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.gridset.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gridset MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gridset lists 15 MCP tools, including check_usage, create_document, draft_content, export_document, find_documents, get_document, get_page, list_brands, list_review_engagement, preview_page, regenerate_page, and search_images.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gridset?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gridset in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Gridset requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gridset is developed by Lumin. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
